FAQ

Questions about coaching institute software

How can a coaching institute manage fee installments?

Create flexible installment plans, auto-send reminders and accept UPI or card links. Sarvlekh tracks every instalment against the student ledger.

Can we run online tests?

Yes. Build tests with negative marking, auto-grade MCQs and publish rank lists and topic-wise analysis instantly.

Does it work for multiple branches?

Yes. Branches share one student database and report to one owner dashboard.

Can the coaching institute system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the coaching institute system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
